opening.argument: The speaker’s remarks center on Bitcoin’s utility, not a pitch to join a service. He says Bitcoin “doesn't do anything in the world,” describes it as a temporary store of savings that may tank, and disputes calling it a store of value. Those are critical assessments of a financial asset, consistent with market analysis. A CoinDepo panel does display an APR figure and a “Get Started” button, but the available evidence does not connect that panel to the speaker’s remarks or establish deceptive solicitation.
